title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard
workpass: 30 — unified evidence provenance across research sources and canonical MemoryOS2
method: WorkPass30 integrates bounded independent source-lineage provenance directly into canonical MemoryOS2 items and carries EvidenceFirewall lineage identities through OrganismCore research ingestion. Same-lineage mirrors and replays cannot add votes or inflate confidence; distinct source lineages are retained in one canonical record, with snapshot/restore and byte-budget accounting. This closes a provenance implementation seam, not retrieval-quality uplift; independent temporal holdout and BM25 promotion remain open.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: One writable canonical owner remains authoritative; WorkPass30 embeds bounded EvidenceFirewall-derived provenance in MemoryOS2 rather than creating a separate source/memory owner.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass29 removes an adapter-level second timeline for temporal queries: Hexis reads the canonical MemoryOS2 validity chain, the default review selects live recent rows, and snapshot/restore + OrganismCore regressions pass. Production browser/Live2D E2E remains open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass30 carries independent external source-lineage provenance into the same canonical MemoryOS2 record with a replay guard, bounded visible trail and restore/byte-budget integration. Duplicate and syndicated source lines cannot ratchet confidence; new independent lineage is preserved. The corrected synthetic retrieval fixture remains at parity with BM25, so retrieval uplift is not claimed and independent temporal holdout remains open.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass20 adds exact action execution/step receipt correlation and a persisted bounded idempotency ledger; duplicate/stale receipts cannot advance later project steps. Entire action→independent external receipt→reafference chain remains partial.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Read-only dossier and fidelity contracts are present; browser-backed corrections and behavioral equivalence remain open.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Conscio/Hexis/WILL local idempotency, queue backpressure and ACK/replay contracts improved; remote provider receipt/reconnect proof remains open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass25 supplies a deterministic private-first temperature-scaling fitter with a group-disjoint validation fold, version/dataset-bound artifact contract, NLL/Brier/ECE eligibility thresholds and provenance propagation into evidence/restore. This is an implemented pipeline only: the real pinned pretrained model and independent final holdout have not been run.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Release metadata and operational readiness reporting improved; dependency-complete app install/build, browser E2E, clean-room restore/rollback, soak and final SBOM/provenance remain open.

normalizedTaskInventory.note: Normalized unique deliverables, not append-only historical tasklist line counts. PARTIAL is not treated as DONE. This inventory score does not establish release readiness.

environmentNote: WorkPass28: runtime TypeScript and focused temporal/retrieval regressions pass. Standalone single-digit numbers are now indexed as retrieval terms in both canonical MemoryOS2 and the BM25 comparison; English/Russian regression cases and temporal expiry guard pass. Algorithm/tokenizer version is included in the configuration fingerprint. Corrected synthetic holdout reports Recall@5 1.00 candidate vs 1.00 BM25 (delta 0.00); this is fixture parity, not an external quality estimate, and candidate remains not-promoted. Independent labelled temporal holdout is still missing. App production build/browser E2E remains unverified; model inference, live providers, rollback, soak and sign-off remain open.
limitations: WorkPass30 closes the bounded source-provenance integration seam but does not claim higher retrieval quality. The corrected synthetic BM25 fixture remains at parity; independent human-labelled temporal holdout, dependency-complete frontend build/browser Live2D E2E, actual pretrained NLI inference, live provider evidence, clean-room recovery/rollback, soak and final RC sign-off remain open.
